name: signal recognition particle 54

function.text: SRP54 encodes signal recognition particle subunit SRP54. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and endoplasmic reticulum signal sequence receptor activity. It participates in granulocyte differentiation and neutrophil chemotaxis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neutropenia, severe congenital, 8, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
